summary: MacroTrack AI backend fully tested via pytest against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All 10/10 tests passed: Gemini-3.1-pro food image analysis, Open Food Facts barcode lookup (success + 404 + 400), food-log/weight/water/activity CRUD, and _id exclusion across every response.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file (~400 lines) — acceptable for current scope; consider splitting if it grows beyond ~700.
/api/analyze-food has no max image size guard; oversized base64 could DOS the Gemini call. Consider rejecting payloads >5 MB.
All log GET endpoints hard-code user_id='default'. Acceptable for single-user MVP but flag for future multi-user auth.
seed_data_creation: Each CRUD test inserts a TEST_ prefixed row and deletes/leaves it; no manual seeding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_macrotrack.py is the regression suite. Real food JPEG is pulled from Wikimedia (with PIL fallback). Gemini call takes ~8-30s; timeout set to 120s. Barcode 737628064502 (Thai Kitchen) confirmed in OpenFoodFacts. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the only base URL used.
